topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I opened the box on my desk to find a beautifully bound book, its cover embossed with intricate designs. Attached was a note: "To my favorite teacher, for the lessons that last a lifetime. Thank you for the inspiration. Warmest regards, Sarah." Sarah, the quiet girl from fifth grade who blossomed into a confident young woman over the years. I remember her love for stories and the way her eyes lit up in literature class. This book must be one of her favorites, a thoughtful choice. I’ll keep it on my shelf, a reminder of the impact we make, often without realizing it. A cup of tea later, and I might just start a new chapter with Sarah's words right beside me.
